#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""统计 data/temperature.csv 中的 temperature 列，输出 result.json 与 report.md。"""
import csv
import json
import os

DATA_PATH = os.path.join("data", "temperature.csv")
RESULT_PATH = "result.json"
REPORT_PATH = "report.md"

# 读取数据
with open(DATA_PATH, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    temps = [float(row["temperature"]) for row in reader if row["temperature"].strip()]

# 统计
stats = {
    "count": len(temps),
    "mean": round(sum(temps) / len(temps), 2),
    "max": max(temps),
    "min": min(temps),
}

# 保存 result.json
with open(RESULT_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(stats, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    f.write("\n")

# 保存 report.md
report = (
    "# 温度统计分析报告\n\n"
    f"- 样本数: {stats['count']}\n"
    f"- 平均温度: {stats['mean']}°C\n"
    f"- 最高温度: {stats['max']}°C\n"
    f"- 最低温度: {stats['min']}°C\n"
)
with open(REPORT_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(report)

print("analysis complete:", stats)
EOF
